stats.title: Distribution statistics
stats.subtitle: Every figure has one definition and adds up from one view to the next.
stats.notAllowed: Statistics are for managers. Your truck of the day is on the dashboard.
stats.rangeInvalid: Pick a period of at most {days} days, the end after the start.
stats.clearLinkFilters: Remove the product / customer filters from a link
stats.clientWilayaHint: As written on the customer file
stats.weightEstimated: Estimated weight: older lines use the product’s current weight.
stats.weightUnknown: Unknown weight ({count} lines): products without a weight, not counted.
stats.notApplicable: These figures cannot follow one of the filters and stay empty: {measures}.
stats.dispersionNote: The figure is in each cell (k = thousands); the colour follows the amount.
stats.targetsOneMonth: Targets are monthly: pick a period inside one month.
stats.myVehicleNone: No truck is assigned to you today.
stats.def_caTtc: Total incl. tax of the delivery notes and direct invoices validated in the period (Algiers day), minus the credit notes of the period. An invoice grouping notes is never counted twice.
stats.def_nbBl: Validated delivery notes and direct invoices, not cancelled.
stats.def_dropSize: Sales / number of notes; empty without notes.
stats.def_skuPerBl: Average number of distinct products per note.
stats.def_weightT: Sum of the weights frozen on the lines / 1000. Lines without a product weight are counted apart (unknown weight), never as 0.
stats.def_activeClients: Distinct customers with at least one note in the period.
stats.def_versements: Valid payments collected in the period (bounced cheques excluded), on the payment’s truck, else the truck its collector drove.
stats.def_recouvrement: Payments / sales of the period. Can exceed 100 % when old debt is paid.
stats.def_bcCount: Orders confirmed in the period (confirmation day), not cancelled.
stats.def_bcTtc: Total incl. tax of those orders.
stats.def_deliveryRate: Quantity delivered / ordered, per line and capped: never above 100 %. Open orders are shown apart.
stats.def_openOrders: Orders confirmed in the period, neither delivered nor cancelled.
stats.def_activeVehicles: Trucks with at least one figure in the period.
stats.def_loadValueTtc: Validated loads to the truck, at the level 1 price incl. tax.
stats.def_loadValueCost: Validated loads to the truck, at the average cost of the validation.
stats.def_fillRate: Weight loaded / truck capacity; empty without a capacity.
stats.def_damagedTtc: Validated returns marked damaged on the truck’s sales.
stats.def_cashEcart: Sum of the differences of the truck’s closings.
stats.def_visitsPlanned: For each day, the stops of the truck routes active on that weekday.
stats.def_visitsDone: Distinct (customer, day) pairs with a visit that was not corrected.
stats.def_visitsSuccess: Visits ending in a sale or an order.
stats.def_dispersion: Sales of each truck for each day of the period, to spot irregular trucks.
stats.def_lostClients: Customers who bought in the comparison period and not in this one.
stats.def_targets: The truck’s figure of the month / its target. These targets are not used for bonuses.
